deployments_detail.use: Silicon One AI networking ASICs (G300 102.4 Tbps, P200) + Nexus One AI-fabric platform for GPU clusters/data centers

Cisco AgenticOps / Cloud Control: agentic AIOps operating model where AI agents act as digital teammates that sense, diagnose root cause via AI reasoning, remediate and validate network/IT issues, with digital-twin testing before production; delivered on the Cisco Cloud Control platform in controlled availability.
Cisco AI Canvas: generative-UI collaborative workspace where IT/network operators and AI agents jointly investigate incidents, preserving context across shifts and escalations; part of Cloud Control.

Cloud Control Studio App Builder / Agent Builder: create custom AI agents and applications from natural-language prompts, integrating OpenAI's Codex and connecting to 40+ platforms (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Wiz, hyperscalers). [OpenAI Codex]
Cisco Motific (from Outshift by Cisco): SaaS to accelerate and govern enterprise generative-AI application deployment, adding security, policy and cost controls over GenAI resources.

Webex AI Assistant for Meetings: AI-powered, voice-activated assistant delivering real-time transcription, closed captioning, meeting highlights and post-meeting summaries across Webex Meetings and devices.

Cisco AI Assistant for Webex Calling: generative-AI assistant generating live call summaries and action-item lists, contextual call-transfer summaries, and searchable post-call transcripts in the Webex app.

Webex AI agents for collaboration: purpose-built agents including Note Taker, Voice AI Receptionist, Meeting Scheduler, Task Agent (auto-creates Jira tickets), Polling Agent and Director Agent (auto camera selection in RoomOS 26); plus Nvidia-built Workspace Advisor 3D room digital twins. [NVIDIA (Workspace Advisor)]
Cisco Deep Network Model: domain-specific large language model trained on unified network data that powers AgenticOps reasoning and troubleshooting across the networking portfolio.

Cisco Webex Contact Center AI: autonomous Webex AI Agent handling complex customer requests end-to-end (e.g. rebooking flights), plus AI Assistant/Agent Assist providing real-time transcription, context and next-best-action recommendations to human agents and topic analytics.

Cisco AI Defense: end-to-end security platform to discover, validate (algorithmic red-teaming) and protect enterprise AI applications and agents against prompt injection, data leakage and model safety risks; expanded with AI BOM, MCP Catalog and real-time agentic guardrails. [Cisco Talos; NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails]

Cisco Hypershield: AI-native, distributed security fabric with ML embedded at each enforcement point (agents, DPUs, smart switches) that continuously learns traffic/workload behavior to autonomously segment networks and deliver graduated (alert vs block) responses.

Splunk AI Assistant for SPL (Splunk, a Cisco company): generative-AI assistant that translates natural language into Splunk Processing Language queries, explains SPL step-by-step, and answers how-to questions from product docs, available from Splunkbase for Splunk Cloud.

Cisco Agentic SOC (Security Cloud Control) with DefenseClaw: AI agents automate security-operations-center workflows and govern local coding agents (OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, OpenClaw), scanning vulnerabilities and enforcing access controls. [OpenAI Codex; Claude Code]
deployments_detail.value: reduces incident response from hours/days to minutes
